method: for each stage the RFC names, the component is resolved by searching its file for the symbol recorded here; an unresolved row is reported as a gap, never as a convention
reading: the decision clock, the fills, the risk engine, admission and the collector each have exactly one owner, and the scheduler has none: that is why the prospective lane is reported as not automated rather than as slow

rows.does_not_own: prices, sizes or admission — a machine emits a decision and nothing else
rows.owns: the rule: one object per family, fed closed bars only, one construction site

rows.does_not_own: the venue's clock: the series defines the period, not an assumption of one hour
rows.owns: the bar's own spacing and therefore the instant its close becomes available

rows.does_not_own: an intrabar path: the policy (stop_first) is enforced and the residual gap optimism is declared
rows.owns: whether a resting stop or target was touched, and the order of an ambiguous bar

rows.does_not_own: which bar is executable: the driver owns the clock and passes the price
rows.owns: fills, commissions, position ids and the cash/realised/unrealised identities

rows.does_not_own: the cost model and the research restatement, which never place orders
rows.owns: approval, refusal, sizing, exposure clamps, loss limits and the kill switch

rows.does_not_own: the research lane's own tag: an experimental lane bypasses it by design and says so
rows.owns: whether a strategy may trade paper at all, from the committed ledger

rows.does_not_own: the collector's execution; the ST6 Windows task belongs to another line and runs every 15 min
rows.owns: nothing yet: no scheduled job runs this package's collector, and none was created

rows.does_not_own: the schedule: it is a manual command while the disk guard reports INSUFFICIENT_FREE_SPACE
rows.owns: appending newly closed public bars to the frozen holdout slice, idempotently
